description: Given a veteran's basic info (era, branch, discharge, conditions, state, household income, dependents, current rating, homeless status), returns matched programs across PACT/Agent Orange/Camp Lejeune/Gulf War presumptives + GI Bill chapters + VA Pension + HUD-VASH/SSVF housing aid + VA Healthcare priority group. Combines several eligibility checks in one call.

age_65_or_disabled.description: Age 65+ OR receives SSDI/SSI OR permanently disabled (for pension eligibility)

branch.description: Service branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, Space Force)

discharge.description: Character of service: honorable, general, OTH, BCD, dishonorable

household_income.description: Annual household income in $ (for pension MAPR + healthcare priority)

state.description: 2-letter state code for state benefits link

name: check_eligibility
title: Benefits eligibility quick check
